name: Should I choose custom trim for an older home or a new construction?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose custom trim for an older home or a new construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom trim is beneficial for both older homes and new constructions. For older homes, it can restore historical accuracy, replicate original detailing, or introduce period-appropriate enhancements that respect the home's heritage. In new constructions, custom trim elevates a basic structure, adding character, warmth, and a unique personality that standard builder-grade trim often lacks. It allows you to define the style from the outset, ensuring a cohesive and sophisticated design throughout the property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom trim benefits older homes by restoring historical accuracy and new constructions by adding unique character and sophistication beyond standard options.
